title: 可轮换负责人与会话选择器
code: integration/worker-registry.js — logical worker identity (project/module/role/route/permission/workspace) kept apart from the physical child and its generation; durable per parent under the shared lock
integration/session-strategy.js — pure rule table S01–S08 plus an append-only decision log with revisions

explainableChoice.observed: resume / queue / compact / restart / new-packet each have a rule id and reasons; independent review and missing prior worker produce new-packet before any reuse rule is considered

noFakeCompact.observed: over-limit without a legal compaction interface produces restart with the explicit reason that no fake compact is recorded

reuseRefused.observed: route, permission, workspace, stale-fact and unclear-failure mismatches all refuse reuse and list every blocker

busyQueues.observed: a busy child queues instead of running two tasks on one session

reuseRateNotAnObjective.observed: the test suite contains no assertion that maximises reuse; the decision log records the choice and its outcome instead

workerIdentityStable.observed: unrelated source changes keep the worker key; a changed route/permission/workspace/module changes it; a parent-ownership conflict keeps the first owner

generationRotation.observed: rotate bumps the generation and keeps bounded history; setHealth refuses a differing child id and demands rotate()

decisionLogRevisions.observed: recordOutcome appends a revision line; the latest revision wins on read and history is never rewritten

boundaries: the rule table is deterministic and makes no model call; it is a first-order rule set, not a learned policy
compact is only chosen when capabilities.compactAvailable is true; today the host exposes no legal core-history compaction to OMC, so restart is the honest answer
a decision record explains a choice; it does not prove the choice was better
notCovered: a real session rotation across two tasks
Desktop display of the decision history
any claim that reuse reduces cost
